entities.summary: Ramon Bejarano is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church and bishop-designate of the Diocese of Monterey since 2025. He was ordained a priest for the Diocese of Stockton in 1998 and later served as an auxiliary bishop for the Diocese of San Diego from 2020 to 2026.
